system.flavor:
Give a thief a jolt and a shove when they step up to your campfire uninvited, knock a drunk back from a friend's table, throw a door open against whoever leaned on it, or send a wolf yelping away from the picket line. The first one through gets the thunder.

Not enough to ward a whole camp, hurt anyone badly, or hold a door against a crowd.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy finishes voluntary movement adjacent to you or an ally within 2 units. Response: On success, deal 1 Lightning Damage and push it 1 unit.

surges.html: Also attack a second enemy within 1 unit of the first with the same roll for 1 Lightning Damage.
